task: ae.datalog small Datalog engine with negation, inequality, stratification, semi-naive evaluation and oracle tests
reasoning_summary: Parser produces a sealed-interface AST with positions; Analyzer checks arity, safety and computes strata by relaxation; Engine evaluates strata to fixpoint in naive or semi-naive mode. Tests cover classic programs, positioned errors, Floyd-Warshall oracle, and a random differential test of both modes; a mutant that drops delta variants was killed.
